mapper.sql: board_no, board_title, board_content, board_writer, reg_date, mod_date, use_yn, board_cnt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board ( board_title, board_content, board_writer, reg_date, mod_date, use_yn ) values ( #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{boardWriter}, #{regDate}, #{modDate}, 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM board WHERE use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT
FROM board WHERE board_no = #{boardNo} AND use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT
FROM board WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY board_no DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE board SET board_title = #{boardTitle}, board_content = #{boardContent}, board_writer = #{boardWriter}, mod_date = CURDATE() WHERE board_no = #{boardNo} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE board SET use_yn = 'N', mod_date = CURDATE() WHERE board_no = #{boardNo} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE board SET board_cnt = board_cnt + 1 WHERE board_no = #{boardNo}
